description: One verdict on a change, from the layers that each have their own measured accuracy: is anything failing, is the changed code tested by something that really reaches it, can the tests in the change fail at all, would they catch a bug (only when prove is asked for, because that costs minutes), and is what was asked for covered. Answers ready, not ready, or cannot say - and cannot say is never rounded up to ready. Use it before claiming a piece of work is finished, including your own: a green test run is not the same as work that is done.

diff.description: A git range, e.g. main...HEAD (the default)

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

prove.description: Also break the changed code and run the tests against it. Costs minutes.

name: is_the_work_done
title: Is this work actually done?
